basis: 4 cells x 20 independent seeds over the 10.2-million-sample grid at d=256; projected from the d=32 fixture by sample-count x dimension scaling, NOT measured at production m
measurement_note: a production-calibration pilot cell must be measured before the multi-million-sample allocation is priced; the projection is a planning bound only

sharding.why_not: optional package, well within the 3-6 h anchor even at the upper projection; serial is sufficient

fallback: serial one-worker execution; bounded memory keeps the allocation safe
rationale: R5 is optional. Bounded-memory accumulation means memory is O(chunk*d + d^2), so no storage-driven parallelism is needed.
